scripts.e2e: pnpm e2e:build && pnpm e2e:capture && pnpm e2e:editor
scripts.e2e:build: pnpm --filter @cropa/desktop build && cargo build -p cropa-desktop --features tauri/custom-protocol --target-dir target/e2e-app
scripts.e2e:capture: cargo test -p cropa-desktop --features tauri/custom-protocol --target-dir target/e2e-app --test e2e_capture -- --ignored --nocapture
